are_you_ok.title: Evacuations ordered for Penley Fire west of Sedalia
are_you_ok.summary: A fast-moving wildfire west of Sedalia forced evacuation orders on July 27 — the week's most acute, life-safety threat to people the reader might be checking on.
are_you_ok.description: A wildfire evacuation order was issued around 5 p.m. Sunday for people within a two-mile radius of West Douglas Fire Station 132.

are_you_ok.title: Sunday was Denver's hottest day in more than 8 years
are_you_ok.summary: A record-breaking heat weekend crescendoed with Denver's hottest day in over 8 years on Sunday; health officials had warned mid-week (Jul 25) of extreme risk to people and pets before the peak arrived.
are_you_ok.description: Denver experiences record-breaking heat as temperatures reach 103 degrees, the highest in over eight years.

thread.title: Denver health specialists warn of extreme heat risks for people and pets
thread.summary: Extreme heat health warning affecting the whole metro population this weekend.
thread.description: With continued high temperatures across Colorado, it's important to recognize the symptoms of heat related illness. Health experts are sharing tips to protect yourself and your pets this weekend.
